draft.subject: One next step for Maple Ventures
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the usual next step is getting your team in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how you want the work split up in Wrenfield and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
